title: Interviewer's travel plans
summary: Palmer asks about the interviewers' route and timing to Memphis, Mississippi, New Orleans and Europe.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: When are you kids going back? Where are you going from here?
I want to go to Memphis first, and then to Jackson, Mississippi, then to New Orleans, and then over to California, and then back to New York and take the plane to Europe.
Well, you... How long is it going to take it? How long... Well, you don't know.
Five weeks. Five weeks. I have already booked my plane back, you know. Oh, yeah.
You need that to for him, but... Well...
